title: PhysBrain 1.0 Technical Report
summary: Vision-language-action models have advanced rapidly, but robot trajectories alone provide limited coverage for learning broad physical understanding. PhysBrain 1.0 studies a complementary route: converting large-scale human egocentric video into structured physical commonsense supervision before robot adaptation. Our data engine extracts scene elements, spatial dynamics, action execution, and depth-aware relations, then turns them into question-answer supervision for training PhysBrain VLMs. The resulting physical priors are further transferred to VLA policies through a capability-preserving and language-sensitive adaptation design. Across multimodal QA benchmarks and embodied control benchmarks, including ERQA, PhysBench, SimplerEnv-WidowX, LIBERO, and RoboCasa, PhysBrain 1.0 achieves SOTA results and shows especially strong out-of-domain performance on SimplerEnv. These results suggest that scaling physical commonsense from human interaction video can provide an effective bridge from multimodal understanding to robot action.
tldr: PhysBrain 1.0 extracts physical commonsense supervision from human egocentric video to train VLMs, then transfers these priors to improve VLA policies, achieving SOTA on embodied control benchmarks.
tldr_zh: PhysBrain 1.0 从人类第一视角视频中提取物理常识监督来训练视觉语言模型，并将这些先验知识转移到视觉-语言-动作策略中，在具身控制基准上实现了SOTA。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型发展迅速，但仅靠机器人轨迹数据难以全面支撑物理常识的学习。PhysBrain 1.0探索了一条互补路径：在大规模人类第一视角视频中提取结构化物理常识监督信号，再将其迁移至机器人策略。我们的数据引擎通过解析场景要素、空间动态、动作执行及深度感知关系，将其转化为问答监督数据以训练PhysBrain视觉语言模型。所得物理先验知识通过能力保持与语言敏感的适配设计，进一步迁移至视觉-语言-动作策略。在多模态问答基准（ERQA、PhysBench）与具身控制基准（SimplerEnv-WidowX、LIBERO、RoboCasa）测试中，PhysBrain 1.0均取得最优结果，在SimplerEnv上尤展现出突出的跨领域泛化能力。这些结果表明，从人类交互视频中规模化提取物理常识，能为多模态理解到机器人动作的迁移构建有效桥梁。

title: Offline Semantic Guidance for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Policy Distillation
summary: Billion-parameter Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies have recently shown impressive performance in robotic manipulation, yet their size and inference cost remain major obstacles for real-time closed-loop control. We introduce \textbf{VLA-AD}, a distillation framework that uses a Vision-Language Model as an offline semantic supervisor to transfer large VLA teachers into lightweight student policies. Instead of relying only on low-level action imitation, VLA-AD augments teacher-provided 7-DoF action targets with high-level semantic guidance, including task phase anchors and multi-frame operating-direction descriptions. These auxiliary signals are used only during training: at test time, the student policy runs independently, with neither the VLA teacher nor the VLM required. We evaluate VLA-AD on three LIBERO benchmark suites. Using OpenVLA-7B as the teacher, our method produces a 158M-parameter student, yielding a $44\times$ reduction in model size while matching the teacher with only a $0.27\%$ average relative gap. The resulting policy runs at 12.5 Hz on an RTX 4090, achieving a $3.28\times$ inference speedup over OpenVLA-7B. We further show that the same semantic distillation pipeline generalizes to a different $π_{0.5}$-4B teacher, where the student outperforms the teacher on two suites and remains within $0.53\%$ on \texttt{libero\_goal}. Additional analysis indicates that phase-level supervision and multi-frame directional cues make the student less sensitive to noisy teacher actions, such as erroneous high-frequency gripper changes. Overall, VLA-AD demonstrates that offline semantic guidance from VLMs can substantially improve the efficiency, robustness, and deployability of VLA policy distillation.
tldr: This paper introduces VLA-AD, a distillation framework that uses offline semantic guidance from a Vision-Language Model to efficiently compress large Vision-Language-Action teacher policies into lightweight, real-time-capable student policies for robotic manipulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了VLA-AD框架，利用视觉语言模型提供的离线语义指导，将大型视觉-语言-动作策略高效压缩为轻量级、实时可部署的机器人操控学生策略。
summary_zh: 十亿参数视觉-语言-动作模型策略在机器人操控任务中展现出卓越性能，但其庞大的规模与高昂的推理成本仍是实现实时闭环控制的主要障碍。本文提出**VLA-AD**——一种蒸馏框架，其采用视觉语言模型作为离线语义监督器，将大型VLA教师模型转化为轻量级学生策略。该方法不仅依赖于低层动作模仿，还通过高层次语义引导（包括任务阶段锚点与多帧操作方向描述）对教师提供的7自由度动作目标进行增强。这些辅助信号仅在训练阶段使用：在测试时，学生策略独立运行，无需调用VLA教师模型或视觉语言模型。我们在三个LIBERO基准测试集上评估VLA-AD方法。以OpenVLA-7B作为教师模型，本方法生成参数量为1.58亿的学生模型，在模型规模缩小44倍的同时，其平均性能与教师模型仅相差0.27%。所得策略在RTX 4090显卡上以12.5 Hz频率运行，相比OpenVLA-7B实现3.28倍的推理加速。我们进一步证明，该语义蒸馏流程可泛化至不同的π_{0.5}-4B教师模型：学生策略在两个测试集上表现优于教师模型，在\texttt{libero\_goal}数据集上仅存在0.53%的性能差距。深入分析表明，阶段级监督与多帧方向线索能降低学生模型对教师动作噪声（如错误的高频夹爪状态切换）的敏感性。总体而言，VLA-AD证明视觉语言模型提供的离线语义引导能显著提升VLA策略蒸馏的效率、鲁棒性与部署可行性。

title: Learning Bilevel Policies over Symbolic World Models for Long-Horizon Planning
summary: We tackle the challenge of building embodied AI agents that can reliably solve long-horizon planning problems. Imitation learning from demonstrations has shown itself to be effective in training robots to solve a diversity of complex tasks requiring fine motor control and manipulation over low-level (LL), continuous environments. Yet, it remains a difficult endeavour to generate long-horizon plans from imitation learning alone. In contrast, high-level (HL), symbolic abstractions facilitate efficient and interpretable long-horizon planning. We propose to combine the strengths of LL imitation learning for manipulation and control, and HL symbolic abstractions for long-horizon planning. We realise this idea via \emph{bilevel policies} of the form $(π^{\mathrm{hl}}, π^{\mathrm{ll}})$, consisting of a neural policy $π^{\mathrm{ll}}$ learned from LL demonstrations, and an HL symbolic policy $π^{\mathrm{hl}}$ that is constructed from symbolic abstractions of the LL demonstrations combined with inductive generalisation. We implement these ideas in the BISON system. Experiments on extended MetaWorld benchmarks demonstrate that BISON generalises to long horizons and problems with greater numbers of objects than those solved by VLA and end-to-end methods, and is more time and memory efficient in training and inference. Notably, when ignoring LL execution, BISON's HL policies can solve HL problems with 10,000 relevant objects in under a minute. Project page: https://dillonzchen.github.io/bison
tldr: The paper proposes bilevel policies combining neural low-level policies learned from imitation learning with high-level symbolic policies for long-horizon planning, improving generalization and efficiency in robotic manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出双层策略，将模仿学习习得的神经低层策略与用于长视野规划的高层符号策略相结合，提升了机器人操作任务的泛化能力和效率。
summary_zh:
摘要：
我们致力于应对构建能够可靠解决长程规划问题的具身人工智能体这一挑战。基于演示的模仿学习已被证明在训练机器人完成各类需要精细运动控制与底层连续环境操作的任务上具有显著效果。然而，仅凭模仿学习生成长程规划仍面临困难。相比之下，高层符号抽象能够促进高效且可解释的长程规划。本研究提出将底层模仿学习在操作控制方面的优势，与高层符号抽象在长程规划方面的优势相结合。我们通过形如 $(π^{\mathrm{hl}}, π^{\mathrm{ll}})$ 的**双层策略**实现这一构想，其中包含从底层演示学习的神经策略 $π^{\mathrm{ll}}$，以及通过底层演示的符号抽象结合归纳泛化构建的高层符号策略 $π^{\mathrm{hl}}$。我们在BISON系统中实现了这些理念。在扩展的MetaWorld基准测试中，实验表明BISON能够泛化到比VLA和端到端方法所处理更长的规划跨度与更多物体数量的问题，且在训练和推理过程中具有更高的时间与内存效率。值得注意的是，在忽略底层执行的情况下，BISON的高层策略能在1分钟内解决涉及10,000个相关物体的高层问题。项目页面：https://dillonzchen.github.io/bison

title: UAM: A Dual-Stream Perspective on Forgetting in VLA Training
summary: Vision--language--action (VLA) models are typically built by fine-tuning a pretrained vision--language model (VLM) on action data. However, we show that this standard recipe systematically erodes the VLM's multimodal competence, a side effect we call the embodiment tax. But do VLAs have to forget? Inspired by the two-stream organization of biological vision, we trace this degradation to a structural bottleneck: current VLAs ask a single encoder to support both language-grounded semantics and control-relevant visual features, whereas biological vision separates recognition and visuomotor control into distinct pathways. Building on this view, we propose the Unified Action Model (UAM), which adds a parallel Dorsal Expert, an analog of the brain's dorsal pathway. To make the Dorsal Expert an effective second pathway and reduce the control-learning burden on the VLM, we initialize it from a pretrained generative model and train it with a mid-level reasoning objective that predicts visual dynamics. This design allows us to train the whole VLA end-to-end on action data alone: with no parameter freezing, no gradient stopping, and no auxiliary VL co-training, UAM retains over $95\%$ of the underlying VLM's multimodal capability and at the same time achieves the highest average success rate among baselines on a variety of manipulation tasks that probe out-of-distribution generalization, including unseen objects, novel object--target compositions, and instruction variation. Together, these results suggest that semantic preservation in VLAs can emerge from architectural separation itself, rather than being enforced by frozen weights or auxiliary data replay, and that this preserved semantic capability can naturally transfer from VLMs to semantic generalization in actions.
tldr: The paper proposes Unified Action Model (UAM), a VLA model with a dual-stream architecture that separates semantic and control-relevant visual features to mitigate forgetting of the pretrained VLM's capabilities during fine-tuning, and achieves strong performance on manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出统一行动模型（UAM），一种采用双流架构的VLA模型，通过分离语义特征和控制相关视觉特征来缓解微调时对预训练VLM能力的遗忘，并在多种操作任务上实现了出色的性能。
summary_zh: 视觉--语言--动作（VLA）模型通常通过对预训练视觉--语言模型（VLM）进行动作数据微调来构建。然而，我们发现这种标准方法会系统性削弱VLM的多模态能力，这种副作用被称为具身化代价。但VLA模型是否必然要遗忘原有能力？受生物视觉双通路结构的启发，我们将这种性能退化归因于结构瓶颈：当前VLA模型要求单个编码器同时支持语言基础语义和控制相关视觉特征，而生物视觉则将识别与视动控制分离至不同通路。基于此洞见，我们提出统一动作模型（UAM），通过引入并行背侧专家——模拟大脑背侧通路的结构。为使背侧专家成为有效第二通路并减轻VLM的控制学习负担，我们采用预训练生成模型初始化该模块，并训练其通过中层推理目标预测视觉动态。这种设计使VLA模型能够仅通过动作数据进行端到端训练：无需参数冻结、梯度截断或辅助VL协同训练，UAM在保持底层VLM超过95%多模态能力的同时，在多种探索分布外泛化的操控任务中（包括未见物体、新物体-目标组合及指令变体）取得了基线模型中最高的平均成功率。这些结果表明，VLA模型的语义保留能力可以通过架构分离自然实现，而非依赖于权重冻结或辅助数据回放，且这种保留的语义能力能够自然地从VLM迁移至动作语义泛化中。

title: Learning Dynamic Pick-and-Place for a Legged Manipulator
summary: Legged manipulators extend robotic capabilities beyond static manipulation by integrating agile locomotion with versatile arm control. However, achieving precise manipulation while maintaining coordinated locomotion remains a major challenge. This work presents a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework for dynamic pick-and-place tasks using a quadruped equipped with a 6-DOF robotic arm. The framework incorporates an explicit mass estimation module enabling adaptive whole-body control for objects with varying weights. In simulation, the system achieves an 86.05% success rate with payloads up to 2.3 kg. The approach is further validated through real-world experiments across six representative scenarios with controlled variations in object physical properties (size and mass) and task heights. Specifically, within a wide vertical workspace ranging from ground level to 1.1~m-high tabletops, the system demonstrates an average success rate of 73.3% for payloads up to 1.3 kg, with an average execution time of 4.06 s. Unlike prior works that handle lightweight objects and execute pick-and-place motions with slow, piecewise motions, the proposed framework exploits concurrent locomotion and manipulation for dynamic, continuous execution. These results demonstrate the potential of quadrupedal mobile manipulators for adaptive, whole-body pick-and-place with heavier payloads and extended workspaces.
tldr: Hierarchical RL for legged manipulators enables dynamic pick-and-place with adaptive mass estimation for objects up to 1.3 kg, validated in simulation and real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: 通过分层强化学习框架，结合质量估计模块，实现四足机器人动态抓放较重物体，在仿真和真实环境中验证了其性能。
summary_zh: 腿式机械手通过将敏捷移动能力与多用途手臂控制相结合，将机器人能力扩展到静态操作之外。然而，在保持协调运动的同时实现精确操作仍是一项重大挑战。本研究提出了一种分层强化学习框架，用于搭载六自由度机械臂的四足机器人执行动态抓取放置任务。该框架包含显式质量估计模块，可针对不同重量物体实现自适应的全身控制。在仿真环境中，系统对高达2.3公斤的有效载荷实现了86.05%的成功率。该方案进一步在六种典型场景中通过真实世界实验得到验证，实验过程系统控制物体物理属性（尺寸与质量）和任务高度的变化。具体而言，在从地面到1.1米高桌面的宽阔垂直工作空间内，系统对高达1.3公斤的有效载荷表现出平均73.3%的成功率，平均执行时间为4.06秒。与以往处理轻量物体且采用缓慢分段式运动执行抓放操作的研究不同，本框架通过并发运动与操作实现了动态连续执行。这些结果证明了四足移动机械臂在适应更重载荷和扩展工作空间方面进行全身抓放操作的潜力。

title: Feedback World Model Enables Precise Guidance of Diffusion Policy
summary: World models aim to improve robotic decision making by predicting the consequences of actions. However, in practice, their predictions often become unreliable once the robot encounters states outside the training distribution, limiting their effectiveness at deployment. We observe that execution itself provides a natural but underutilized signal: after each action, the robot directly observes the true next state, revealing the mismatch between predicted and actual outcomes. Building on this insight, we propose feedback world model, a new paradigm that closes the loop between prediction and observation at inference time. Instead of treating the world model as a static open-loop predictor, our method maintains a lightweight feedback state that is updated online to iteratively correct future predictions, compensating for model errors using real-time observations without additional training data or parameter updates. We show that this process can be interpreted as a latent-space observer and admits convergence guarantees under mild conditions. We further introduce action-aware guidance to better translate corrected predictions into control by emphasizing action-controllable components while suppressing irrelevant variations. Experiments on LIBERO-Plus, Robomimic, and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate that our method substantially improves both prediction accuracy and policy performance under distribution shift. In particular, it reduces world model prediction error by up to 76.4% and improves out-of-distribution (OOD) success rate by 30%. These results show that incorporating real-time feedback at inference time provides a simple yet powerful alternative to static world modeling.
tldr: Proposes a feedback world model that uses real-time observations to iteratively correct predictions at inference time, improving robustness under distribution shift for robotic manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 提出一种反馈世界模型，利用实时观测在推理时迭代修正预测，从而提升机器人操作任务在分布偏移下的鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 世界模型旨在通过预测行动结果来提升机器人决策能力，但在实际应用中，一旦机器人遇到超出训练分布的状态，其预测往往变得不可靠，从而限制了部署时的有效性。我们注意到执行过程本身提供了一个天然但未被充分利用的信号：每次行动后，机器人可直接观测到真实的下一个状态，这揭示了预测结果与实际结果之间的差异。基于这一洞察，我们提出了反馈世界模型，这是一种在推理阶段闭合预测与观测回路的新范式。该方法摒弃将世界模型视为静态开环预测器的传统思路，转而维护一个轻量级反馈状态，通过在线更新迭代修正未来预测，利用实时观测补偿模型误差，且无需额外训练数据或参数更新。我们证明了这一过程可被解释为潜在空间观测器，并在温和条件下具备收敛性保证。我们进一步引入了动作感知引导机制，通过强化动作可控成分并抑制无关变量，更好地将修正后的预测转化为控制策略。在LIBERO-Plus、Robomimic以及真实世界操作任务上的实验表明，该方法在分布偏移情况下显著提升了预测精度与策略性能。具体而言，世界模型预测误差最高降低76.4%，分布外（OOD）任务成功率提升30%。这些结果表明，在推理阶段引入实时反馈为静态世界建模提供了简单而有效的替代方案。

title: SkiP: When to Skip and When to Refine for Efficient Robot Manipulation
summary: Previous imitation learning policies predict future actions at every control step, whether in smooth motion phases or precise, contact-rich operation phases. This uniform treatment is wasteful: most steps in a manipulation trajectory traverse free space and carry little task-relevant information, while a small fraction of \emph{key} steps around contacts, grasps, and alignment demand dense, high-resolution prediction. We propose a novel \emph{action relabeling} mechanism: at each timestep in a skip segment, we replace the behavior cloning target with the action at the entrance of the next key segment, enabling the policy to leap over redundant steps in a single decision. The resulting \textbf{Skip Policy (SkiP)} dynamically leaps over skip segments and intensively refines actions in key segments, within a single unified network requiring no learned skip planner or hierarchical structure. To automatically partition demonstrations into key and skip segments without manual annotation, we introduce \emph{Motion Spectrum Keying} (MSK), a fast, task-agnostic procedure that detects local motion complexity from action signals. Extensive experiments across 72 simulated manipulation tasks and three real-robot tasks show that SkiP reduces executed steps by $15$--$40\%$ while matching or improving success rates across various policy backbones. Project page: \texttt{https://pgq18.github.io/SkiP-page/}.
tldr: The paper introduces SkiP, a policy that dynamically skips redundant motion steps and refines actions in key contact-rich segments, reducing executed steps while maintaining or improving success rates in manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出SkiP策略，动态跳过冗余运动步骤并细化关键接触密集段动作，在保持或提升任务成功率的同时，显著减少机器人操控的执行步骤。
summary_zh: 以往的模仿学习策略在每个控制步骤都预测未来动作，无论是在平滑运动阶段还是在精确、接触密集的操作阶段。这种统一处理是低效的：机械臂操作轨迹中的大多数步骤都处于自由空间中，携带的任务相关信息很少；而只有一小部分围绕接触、抓取和对齐的**关键**步骤需要进行密集、高分辨率的预测。我们提出了一种新颖的**动作重标注**机制：在跳跃段的每个时间步，我们将行为克隆目标替换为下一个关键段入口处的动作，使策略能够在单个决策中跳过冗余步骤。由此产生的**跳跃策略（SkiP）** 能动态跳过跳跃段，并在关键段内密集优化动作，且仅需一个统一网络，无需学习跳跃规划器或分层结构。为了在没有人工标注的情况下自动将演示划分为关键段和跳跃段，我们引入了**运动频谱关键检测（MSK）**，这是一种快速、任务无关的方法，可从动作信号中检测局部运动复杂性。在72个模拟操作任务和三个真实机器人任务上的大量实验表明，SkiP在各种策略骨干网络下，将执行步骤减少了15-40%，同时保持或提高了任务成功率。项目页面：\texttt{https://pgq18.github.io/SkiP-page/}。

title: Residual Reinforcement Learning for Robot Teleoperation under Stochastic Delays
summary: Stochastic communication delays in teleoperation introduce signal discontinuities that undermine control stability and degrade control performance. Consequently, the conventional reinforcement learning (RL) methods struggle with the delayed observations due to the delay-induced observations, leading to high-frequency chattering. To address this, we propose a hybrid control framework, delay-resilient RL, integrating a state estimator utilizing Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) with a residual RL policy, which is resilient to stochastic delays. The LSTM reconstructs smooth, continuous state estimates from delayed observations, enabling the RL agent to learn a residual torque compensation policy that balances tracking accuracy with velocity smoothness. Experimental validation on Franka Panda robots demonstrates that our approach significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art baselines, ensuring robust and stable teleoperation even under high-variance stochastic delays.
tldr: Proposes a hybrid delay-resilient RL framework combining LSTM state estimation with residual RL to enable stable robot teleoperation under stochastic communication delays, validated on Franka Panda robots.
tldr_zh: 提出一种结合LSTM状态估计与残差强化学习的混合抗延迟控制框架，在随机通信延迟下实现稳定的机器人遥操作，并在Franka Panda机器人上验证。
summary_zh: 远程操作中的随机通信延迟会引入信号不连续性，破坏控制稳定性并降低控制性能。传统的强化学习方法因延迟观测值而难以处理延迟观测，导致高频颤振。为此，我们提出一种混合控制框架——延迟鲁棒强化学习，该方法将利用长短期记忆网络的状态估计器与残差强化学习策略相结合，能够有效应对随机延迟。长短期记忆网络从延迟观测中重构出平滑、连续的状态估计，使强化学习智能体能够学习一种平衡跟踪精度与速度平滑性的残差力矩补偿策略。在Franka Panda机器人上的实验验证表明，该方法显著优于现有先进基线，即使在高度变化的随机延迟下也能确保远程操作具有鲁棒性和稳定性。

title: HoloMotion-1 Technical Report
summary:
In this report, we present HoloMotion-1, a humanoid motion foundation model for zero-shot whole-body motion tracking. A key innovation of HoloMotion-1 is to scale control-policy training with a large-scale hybrid motion corpus, where video-reconstructed motions from in-the-wild videos provide the dominant source of motion diversity, while curated motion-capture and in-house motion data provide higher-fidelity supervision and deployment-oriented coverage. This data regime enables HoloMotion-1 to move beyond conventional MoCap-only training and exposes the policy to substantially broader behaviors, capture conditions, and motion styles.
  Learning from such heterogeneous data introduces new challenges, including reconstruction noise, source-domain mismatch, uneven motion quality, and the need for temporal modeling under large behavioral variation. To address these challenges, HoloMotion-1 integrates large-capacity temporal modeling, a sparsely activated Mixture-of-Experts Transformer with KV-cache inference for real-time control, and a sequence-level training strategy that improves learning efficiency on extended motion sequences. Extensive experiments on multiple unseen motion benchmarks show that HoloMotion-1 generalizes robustly across diverse motion types and capture conditions, significantly improves tracking accuracy over prior methods, and transfers directly to a real humanoid robot without task-specific fine-tuning.
tldr: HoloMotion-1 is a humanoid motion foundation model that learns from a large-scale hybrid motion corpus (video-reconstructed motions, MoCap, and in-house data) to achieve zero-shot whole-body motion tracking, transferring directly to a real humanoid robot.
tldr_zh: HoloMotion-1 是一个通过大规模混合运动数据（视频重建运动、动捕数据和内部数据）训练的人形机器人运动基础模型，实现了零样本全身运动跟踪，并可直接迁移到真实人形机器人上。
summary_zh:
本报告介绍了HoloMotion-1——一种用于零样本全身运动追踪的人形机器人运动基础模型。HoloMotion-1的核心创新在于通过大规模混合运动数据集进行控制策略训练的规模化扩展：从海量野生视频重建的运动数据构成了运动多样性的主要来源，而经过筛选的运动捕捉数据与内部运动数据则提供了更高保真度的监督信号及面向部署场景的覆盖范围。这种数据机制使HoloMotion-1突破了传统仅依赖运动捕捉数据的训练范式，让策略模型能够接触到更广泛的行为模式、采集条件与运动风格。

从这种异构数据中学习带来了新的挑战，包括重建噪声、源域不匹配、运动质量不均以及大行为变化下的时序建模需求。为应对这些挑战，HoloMotion-1融合了三大技术要素：大容量时序建模架构、采用稀疏激活专家混合机制并配备KV缓存推理的实时控制Transformer，以及提升长序列运动学习效率的序列级训练策略。在多组未见运动基准测试上的广泛实验表明，HoloMotion-1能够稳健地泛化至各类运动形态与采集条件，在跟踪精度上显著超越现有方法，且无需任务特定微调即可直接迁移至真实人形机器人系统。

title: FLASH: Efficient Visuomotor Policy via Sparse Sampling
summary: Generative models such as diffusion and flow matching have become dominant paradigms for visuomotor policy learning, yet their reliance on iterative denoising incurs high inference latency incompatible with real-time robotic control. We present Fast Legendre-polynomial Action policy via Sparse History-anchored flow (FLASH Policy), which replaces discrete action-chunk generation with continuous Legendre polynomial trajectory representation. Specifically, by fitting expert demonstrations under sparse temporal sampling, FLASH enables a single inference to cover a significantly extended action horizon. To further accelerate generation, FLASH initiates the flow matching process from history polynomial coefficients rather than uninformative Gaussian noise, shortening the transport distance and enabling accurate single-step inference. Moreover, analytic polynomial differentiation directly provides desired velocity feed-forward signals to the torque controller without numerical approximation. Extensive experiments on five simulated and two real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate that FLASH achieves state-of-the-art success rates ($\ge 92\%$ across all tasks), a per-episode inference time of $31.40\,ms$ (up to $175\times$ faster than diffusion policies and $18\times$ faster than prior flow matching policies), up to $4\times$ faster training convergence than ACT, and $5\times$ to $7\times$ reduction in controller tracking error compared to discrete-action baselines.
tldr: This paper introduces FLASH, a fast visuomotor policy for robot manipulation that uses Legendre polynomial representation and sparse flow matching for low-latency, high-accuracy action generation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出FLASH，一种用于机器人操作的快速视觉运动策略，利用勒让德多项式表示和稀疏流匹配，实现低延迟、高精度的动作生成。
summary_zh: 扩散模型与流匹配等生成模型已成为视觉运动策略学习的主流范式，但其依赖迭代去噪的过程导致推理延迟过高，难以满足实时机器人控制的需求。本文提出基于稀疏历史锚定流的快速勒让德多项式动作策略（FLASH Policy），通过连续勒让德多项式轨迹表示替代离散动作块生成方法。具体而言，通过稀疏时间采样下的专家示教拟合，FLASH仅需单次推理即可覆盖显著延长的动作时域。为加速生成过程，FLASH从历史多项式系数（而非无信息的高斯噪声）启动流匹配过程，从而缩短传输距离并实现精准的单步推理。此外，解析多项式微分可直接为扭矩控制器提供期望的速度前馈信号，无需数值近似。在五项仿真与两项真实世界操作任务上的大量实验表明：FLASH实现了最先进的任务成功率（全任务≥92%），单回合推理时间仅需31.40毫秒（比扩散策略快达175倍，比现有流匹配策略快18倍），训练收敛速度比ACT快达4倍，与离散动作基线相比控制器跟踪误差降低5至7倍。

title: FocalPolicy: Frequency-Optimized Chunking and Locally Anchored Flow Matching for Coherent Visuomotor Policy
summary: Visuomotor policies aim to learn complex manipulation tasks from expert demonstrations. However, generating smooth and coherent trajectories remains challenging, as it requires balancing proximal precision with distal foresight. Existing approaches typically focus on optimizing intra-chunk action distributions, often neglecting the inter-chunk coherence. Consequently, inter-chunk discontinuities significantly impede the learning of coherent long-horizon actions. To overcome this limitation and achieve a synergetic balance between precision and foresight, we propose FocalPolicy, a foresight-aware visuomotor policy that combines Frequency-Optimized Chunking with Locally Anchored flow matching. We introduce a foresight composite objective that supervises time-domain alignment within the proximal actions while regularizing frequency-domain structure over multiple future action chunks to improve cross-chunk coherence. To efficiently learn complex action distributions, we design locally anchored campling to enhance target signal propagation efficiency during consistency flow matching training. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FocalPolicy outperforms existing approaches and confirm the generalizability of our modules to other baselines. Project website: https://focalpolicy.github.io/
tldr: Proposes FocalPolicy, a visuomotor policy for manipulation that uses frequency-optimized chunking and locally anchored flow matching to improve long-horizon action coherence and smoothness.
tldr_zh: 提出FocalPolicy，一种用于操作的视觉运动策略，采用频率优化分块和局部锚定流匹配来改善长时程动作的连贯性与平滑性。
summary_zh: 视觉运动策略旨在通过专家示教学习复杂的操作任务。然而，生成平滑连贯的轨迹仍然具有挑战性，因为需要在近端精度与远端前瞻性之间取得平衡。现有方法通常专注于优化片段内的动作分布，而忽略了片段间的连贯性，导致片段间的不连续性严重阻碍了连贯长时域动作的学习。为克服这一局限并在精度与前瞻性之间实现协同平衡，我们提出了FocalPolicy，这是一种具备前瞻意识的视觉运动策略，它结合了频率优化分块与局部锚定流匹配方法。我们引入了一种前瞻复合目标函数，在监督近端动作时域对齐的同时，通过正则化多个未来动作片段的频域结构来提升跨片段连贯性。为了高效学习复杂的动作分布，我们设计了局部锚定采样机制，以增强一致性流匹配训练过程中目标信号的传播效率。大量实验表明，FocalPolicy性能优于现有方法，并验证了所提模块在其他基线模型上的可推广性。项目网站：https://focalpolicy.github.io/

title: Towards Trustworthy and Explainable AI for Perception Models: From Concept to Prototype Vehicle Deployment
summary: Deep Neural Networks have become the dominant solution for Autonomous Driving perception, but their opacity conflicts with emerging Trustworthy AI guidelines and complicates safety assurance, debugging, and human oversight. While theoretical frameworks for safe and Explainable AI (XAI) exist, concrete implementations of Trustworthy AI for 3D scene understanding remain scarce. We address this gap by proposing a Trustworthy AI perception module that is remarkably robust, integrates faithful explainability, and calibrated uncertainty estimates. Building on a transformer-based detector, we derive explanation from the attention mechanism at inference time and validate their faithfulness using perturbation-based consistency tests. We further integrate an uncertainty estimation and calibration module, and apply robustness-enhancing training methods. Experiments show faithful saliency behavior, improved robustness, and well-calibrated uncertainty estimates. Finally, we deploy these Trustworthy AI elements in a prototype vehicle and provide an XAI Interface that visualizes documentation artifacts, model uncertainty state, and saliency maps, demonstrating the feasibility of trustworthy perception monitoring in real time. Supplementary materials are available at https://tillbeemelmanns.github.io/trustworthy_ai/ .
tldr: Proposes a trustworthy perception module for autonomous driving, integrating attention-based explanations, calibrated uncertainty, and robustness training, and demonstrates deployment on a prototype vehicle.
tldr_zh: 提出用于自动驾驶的可信感知模块，集成基于注意力的可解释性、标定的不确定性估计和鲁棒性训练，并在原型车上演示了部署。
summary_zh: 深度神经网络已成为自动驾驶感知领域的主导解决方案，但其不透明性与新兴的可信人工智能指导原则相冲突，并使安全保障、调试和人工监督复杂化。尽管安全和可解释人工智能（XAI）的理论框架已存在，但面向三维场景理解的可信人工智能具体实现仍极为匮乏。针对这一空白，我们提出一种可信人工智能感知模块，该模块具有显著鲁棒性，集成了可靠的可解释性以及校准后的不确定性估计。基于Transformer架构的检测器，我们在推理时从注意力机制中提取解释，并通过基于扰动的致性测试验证其可靠性。我们进一步整合了不确定性估计与校准模块，并应用了鲁棒性增强训练方法。实验结果显示其具有可靠的显著性特征行为、改进的鲁棒性以及良好校准的不确定性估计。最后，我们将这些可信人工智能组件部署于原型车辆中，并提供可可视化文档记录、模型不确定状态和显著性图的可解释人工智能界面，证明了实时可信感知监测的可行性。补充材料详见 https://tillbeemelmanns.github.io/trustworthy_ai/。

title: GAP: Geometric Anchor Pre-training for Data-Efficient Visuomotor Learning of Manipulation Tasks
summary: Learning visuomotor policies from scarce expert demonstrations remains a core challenge in robotic manipulation. A primary hurdle lies in distilling high-dimensional RGB representations into control-relevant geometry without overfitting. While using frozen pre-trained Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) improves data efficiency, it also shifts most task adaptation onto a small spatial pooling module, which can latch onto task-irrelevant shortcuts and lose geometric grounding when finetuned with few data samples. More broadly, pre-trained visual representations used for policy learning have been observed to struggle under even minor scene perturbations, highlighting the need for robustness-oriented inductive biases. We propose Geometric Anchor Pre-training (GAP), a simple, action-free warm-up stage that regularizes the spatial adapter before downstream imitation learning. GAP pre-trains the pooling layer on a lightweight simulated proxy task where object masks are available at no cost, encouraging the adapter to produce keypoints that lie on the object, cover its spatial extent, and remain sharp and repeatable over time. This yields stable geometric anchors that provide a reliable coordinate interface for few-shot policy learning, while keeping the VFM frozen. We evaluate GAP on RoboMimic and ManiSkill under severe data scarcity (15-50 demonstrations) and domain shift. A simple adapter regularized with GAP consistently outperforms stronger attention-based poolers and end-to-end fine-tuning, achieving 62% success on RoboMimic Can with 15 demonstrations (+16% over AFA), 63% on the long-horizon high-precision Tool Hang task with 50 demonstrations, and 61% on ManiSkill StackCube with 30 demonstrations (+11% over full fine-tuning). The proxy stage is lightweight and fully decoupled from downstream tasks, making it practical to reuse across environments and manipulation skills.
tldr: The paper proposes Geometric Anchor Pre-training (GAP), a lightweight action-free warm-up stage to regularize a spatial adapter for visuomotor policy learning, improving data efficiency and geometric robustness in manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出几何锚点预训练（GAP），一种轻量级、无动作的预热阶段，用于正则化视觉运动策略学习中的空间适配器，提高操作任务中的数据效率和几何鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 在机器人操控领域，从稀缺的专家演示中学习视觉运动策略仍然是一个核心挑战。主要难点在于如何将高维RGB表征提炼为与操控相关的几何信息而不发生过拟合。虽然使用冻结的预训练视觉基础模型（VFMs）提升了数据效率，但这也将大部分任务适配转移至一个微小的空间池化模块，该模块在少量数据样本微调时容易产生与任务无关的捷径，并丧失几何基础性。更广泛而言，用于策略学习的预训练视觉表征已被观察到在轻微场景扰动下便难以保持稳定，这凸显了对鲁棒性归纳偏置的需求。我们提出几何锚点预训练方法，这是一个简单、无需动作的预热阶段，能在下游模仿学习前对空间适配器进行正则化。GAP方法基于轻量级仿真代理任务预训练池化层——该任务可免费获取物体掩码，从而引导适配器生成位于物体表面、覆盖其空间范围、并随时间保持清晰与可复现的关键点。由此产生稳定的几何锚点，为小样本策略学习提供可靠的坐标接口，同时保持视觉基础模型冻结。我们在RoboMimic和ManiSkill数据集上，针对极端数据稀缺（15-50个演示）和域偏移场景评估了GAP。经GAP正则化的简单适配器持续优于基于注意力的强化池化方法及端到端微调，在RoboMimic Can任务中以15个演示达成62%成功率（较AFA提升16%），在长时程高精度Tool Hang任务中以50个演示取得63%成功率，在ManiSkill StackCube任务中以30个演示实现61%成功率（较全量微调提升11%）。该代理训练阶段轻量且完全与下游任务解耦，可跨环境和操控技能灵活复用。

title: Identifiable Token Correspondence for World Models
summary: Transformer-based world models have shown strong performance in visual reinforcement learning, but often suffer from temporal inconsistency in long-horizon rollouts, including object duplication, disappearance, and transmutation. A key reason is that most existing approaches treat next-frame prediction purely as a token generation problem, without explicitly modeling correspondence between tokens across time. We formulate next-frame prediction as a structured probabilistic inference problem with latent token correspondence variables, deriving a model in which each next-frame token is explained either by copying a token from the previous frame or by generating a new token. Our experiments show state-of-the-art performance on 4 challenging benchmarks. The proposed method achieves a return of 72.5% and a score of 35.6% on the Craftax-classic benchmark, significantly surpassing the previous best of 67.4% and 27.9%. We release our source code on https://github.com/snu-mllab/Identifiable-Token-Correspondence.
tldr: This paper improves transformer-based world models for visual reinforcement learning by formulating next-frame prediction as a structured probabilistic inference problem with latent token correspondence, addressing temporal inconsistency and achieving state-of-the-art results on benchmarks like Craftax.
tldr_zh: 本文通过将下一帧预测构建为带有潜在令牌对应关系的结构化概率推理问题，改进了用于视觉强化学习的基于Transformer的世界模型，解决了时间不一致性问题，并在Craftax等基准测试中取得了最先进的结果。
summary_zh: 基于Transformer的世界模型在视觉强化学习中表现出色，但长期推演时常存在时序不一致问题，包括物体重复、消失与属性突变。其关键原因在于，现有方法大多将下一帧预测纯粹视为令牌生成问题，而未显式建模跨时间令牌的对应关系。我们将下一帧预测构建为具有潜在令牌对应变量的结构化概率推理问题，推导出一个模型，其中每个下一帧令牌要么通过复制前一帧的令牌生成，要么通过生成新令牌来解释。实验结果表明，该方法在四个具有挑战性的基准测试中达到了最先进的性能。在Craftax经典基准测试中，所提方法实现了72.5%的回报率和35.6%的得分，显著超越此前最佳结果的67.4%和27.9%。我们已在https://github.com/snu-mllab/Identifiable-Token-Correspondence开源相关代码。

title: Offline Reinforcement Learning with Universal Horizon Models
summary: Model-based reinforcement learning (RL) offers a compelling approach to offline RL by enabling value learning on imagined on-policy trajectories. However, it often suffers from compounding errors due to repeated model inference on self-generated states. While geometric horizon models (GHM) alleviate this issue through direct prediction over a discounted infinite-horizon future, they remain challenged in accurately modeling distant future states. To this end, we introduce universal horizon models (UHM), a generalization of GHM that directly predicts future states under arbitrary horizons. Leveraging this flexibility, we propose a scalable value learning method that employs a winsorized horizon distribution to stabilize training by capping excessively large horizons. Experimental results on 100 challenging OGBench tasks demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms competitive baselines, particularly on tasks with highly suboptimal datasets and those requiring long-horizon reasoning. Project page: https://rllab-snu.github.io/projects/UHM/
tldr: The paper proposes universal horizon models, a generalization of geometric horizon models for offline RL that directly predicts future states under arbitrary horizons, and introduces a winsorized horizon distribution to stabilize value learning. The method outperforms baselines on tasks with suboptimal data and long-horizon reasoning.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出通用水平模型，这是几何水平模型在离线强化学习中的推广，可直接预测任意水平下的未来状态，并引入缩尾水平分布以稳定值学习。该方法在次优数据和长水平推理任务上优于基线。
summary_zh: 基于模型的强化学习（RL）通过利用想象中在线策略轨迹进行价值学习，为离线强化学习提供了一种引人注目的方法。然而，该方法常因对自生成状态反复进行模型推理而产生误差累积问题。虽然几何时域模型（GHM）通过直接预测折现后的无限时域未来状态来缓解这一问题，但在准确建模远距离未来状态方面仍面临挑战。为此，我们提出了通用时域模型（UHM）——这是GHM的泛化形式，能够直接预测任意时域下的未来状态。利用这种灵活性，我们提出了一种可扩展的价值学习方法，该方法采用温莎化时域分布，通过限制过大的时域范围来稳定训练过程。在100项具有挑战性的OGBench任务上的实验结果表明，所提出的方法优于现有竞争基线，尤其在数据集高度次优及需要长时域推理的任务上表现突出。项目页面：https://rllab-snu.github.io/projects/UHM/

title: WorldVLN: Autoregressive World Action Model for Aerial Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Aerial vision-language navigation (VLN) requires agents to follow natural-language instructions through closed-loop perception and action in 3D environments. We argue that aerial VLN can be formulated as a prediction-driven world-action problem: the agent should anticipate latent world evolution and act according to the predicted consequences. To this end, we propose WorldVLN, the first autoregressive world action model for aerial VLN. Unlike full-sequence video-generation world models that generate an entire visual clip, WorldVLN adapts a latent autoregressive video backbone to predict short-horizon world-state transitions and directly decodes them into executable waypoint actions. After each action segment is executed, newly received observations are encoded back into the autoregressive context, enabling closed-loop world-action prediction. We further introduce a two-stage training framework that first grounds the video prior in instruction-conditioned navigation dynamics and then develops Action-aware GRPO, the first reinforcement learning method tailored to autoregressive WAMs, to optimize waypoint decisions through their downstream rollout consequences. On public outdoor and indoor benchmarks, WorldVLN consistently outperforms existing Vision-Language-Action baselines with 12\%+ success-rate gains and larger advantages on challenging cases. It further transfers zero-shot to real drone deployment, suggesting that the proposed WorldVLN offers a promising route for spatial action tasks. Demos and code are available at https://embodiedcity.github.io/WorldVLN/.
tldr: WorldVLN is an autoregressive world action model for aerial vision-language navigation that predicts short-horizon world-state transitions and decodes them into executable waypoint actions, trained with a novel reinforcement learning method.
tldr_zh: WorldVLN是一个用于空中视觉语言导航的自回归世界行动模型，它预测短期世界状态转换并解码为可执行的航点行动，采用一种新颖的强化学习方法进行训练。
summary_zh: 空中视觉语言导航要求智能体在三维环境中通过闭环感知与动作执行自然语言指令。我们提出，空中视觉语言导航可被建模为预测驱动的世界-行动问题：智能体应预测潜在世界状态演变，并根据预测结果采取行动。为此，我们提出首个自回归世界行动模型——WorldVLN。与生成完整视频序列的传统世界模型不同，WorldVLN采用潜空间自回归视频主干网络，预测短时域世界状态转移，并直接解码为可执行的路径点动作。每段动作执行后，新接收的观测信息被重新编码至自回归上下文，实现闭环的世界-行动预测。我们进一步提出两阶段训练框架：首先将视频先验信息与指令条件导航动态对齐，随后开发首个专为自回归世界行动模型设计的强化学习方法——行动感知GRPO，通过下游推演结果优化路径点决策。在公开的室外与室内基准测试中，WorldVLN相较现有视觉-语言-动作基线模型持续取得12%以上的成功率提升，在复杂场景中优势更为显著。该模型还能零样本迁移至真实无人机部署，表明WorldVLN为空间行动任务提供了可行路径。演示与代码详见https://embodiedcity.github.io/WorldVLN/。

title: WorldAct: Activating Monolithic 3D Worlds into Interactive-Ready Object-Centric Scenes
summary: Recent 3D world modeling systems based on generative scene synthesis, such as Marble, can create coherent and explorable 3D environments, yet their outputs are typically static monolithic assets with limited editability and physical interaction. This restricts their use in immersive content creation and embodied simulation, where generated worlds must be actively modified and manipulated. To tackle this challenge, we present WorldAct, a framework that converts static generated 3D worlds into editable and interaction-ready scenes. WorldAct uses a multimodal agent to guide scene decomposition, identify actionable objects, reconstruct geometrically aligned object-level meshes for interaction, and restore the residual background via 3D inpainting. The resulting scenes support object-level editing, collision-aware manipulation, and embodied task execution while preserving global scene coherence. Experiments show that WorldAct enables richer interaction scenarios than the original generated scenes, suggesting a practical path toward editable and interactive 3D world models.
tldr: WorldAct converts static generated 3D worlds into editable, interaction-ready object-centric scenes via a multimodal agent, enabling object-level editing, collision-aware manipulation, and embodied task execution.
tldr_zh: WorldAct 通过多模态智能体将静态生成的 3D 世界转换为可编辑、可交互的以物体为中心的场景，支持物体级编辑、碰撞感知的操作和具身任务执行。
summary_zh: 近期基于生成式场景合成的三维世界建模系统（如Marble）能够创建连贯且可探索的三维环境，但其输出通常为静态整体资源，可编辑性和物理交互能力有限。这限制了它们在沉浸式内容创作和具身模拟中的应用，因为生成的世界需要被主动修改与操控。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了WorldAct框架，将静态生成的三维世界转换为可编辑且支持交互的场景。WorldAct采用多模态智能体引导场景解构，识别可操作对象，重建几何对齐的物体级网格以实现交互，并通过三维修复技术还原剩余背景。生成的场景支持物体级编辑、碰撞感知操控和具身任务执行，同时保持全局场景连贯性。实验表明，相较于原始生成场景，WorldAct能实现更丰富的交互场景，为可编辑、可交互的三维世界模型提供了一条实用路径。

title: EgoExo-WM: Unlocking Exo Video for Ego World Models
summary: Egocentric world models present a promising direction for enabling agents to predict and plan, but their performance is constrained by the limited availability of egocentric training data and its inherent partial observability of humans' physical actions. In contrast, exocentric video is abundant and reveals body poses well, but lacks direct alignment with an agent's action space -- and is not egocentric. We propose a method to bridge this gap by extracting structured body pose from exocentric video as a representation of action and transforming the exocentric video to egocentric video, informed by a human kinematics prior. This process unlocks the integration of in-the-wild exocentric data for egocentric world model training. We show that training whole-body action-conditioned egocentric world models with our converted data significantly improves both prediction quality and downstream planning performance, where we infer the sequence of body poses needed to achieve a visual goal state. Our approach paves the way to enlist arbitrary in-the-wild videos for building powerful egocentric world models, furthering applications in robot planning and augmented-reality guidance.
tldr: Proposes a method to extract structured body pose from exocentric video and transform it to egocentric video, enabling training of egocentric world models with abundant exocentric data, improving prediction and planning.
tldr_zh: 提出一种从外中心视角视频提取结构化身体姿态并转换为自我中心视角视频的方法，从而利用大量外中心数据训练自我中心世界模型，提升预测和规划性能。
summary_zh: 自我中心世界模型为智能体实现预测与规划提供了前景广阔的发展方向，但其性能受限于自我中心训练数据的稀缺性及对人类物理动作固有的局部可观测性。相比之下，异中心视角视频虽数据丰富且能清晰呈现身体姿态，却因缺乏与智能体动作空间的直接对应关系——且非自我中心视角——而难以直接应用。本研究提出一种方法以弥合此鸿沟：通过提取异中心视频中的结构化身体姿态作为动作表征，并基于人体运动学先验将异中心视频转换为自我中心视角视频。这一过程使得利用野外异中心数据进行自我中心世界模型训练成为可能。实验表明，使用经转换数据训练全身动作条件化自我中心世界模型，能显著提升预测质量与下游规划性能，其中我们通过推断达成视觉目标状态所需的身体姿态序列实现规划。该方法为利用任意野外视频构建强大的自我中心世界模型开辟了新途径，进一步推动了机器人规划与增强现实引导等应用领域的发展。

title: Learn Where Outcomes Diverge: Efficient VLA RL via Probabilistic Chunk Masking
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) allows vision-language-action (VLA) policies to generalize beyond their training distribution by optimizing directly for task success, but post-training is computationally expensive. A natural response has been to speed rollout collection through faster simulators and world models. In GRPO-based VLA RL, we find that the dominant cost lies elsewhere: gradient computation accounts for approximately 78% of wall-clock time per step in our runs, while rollout collection accounts for only 21%. Gradient cost dominates because much of this computation is spent on phases that contribute little to learning. GRPO's learning signal is driven by advantage variance: only phases where successful and failed rollouts diverge produce learning signal. However, GRPO assigns the same advantage to every chunk in a rollout. As a result, actor-update compute is spent uniformly across the trajectory, including phases the policy already handles after pre-training and supervised fine-tuning. This paper presents Probabilistic Chunk Masking (PCM), a drop-in modification to GRPO that allocates gradient computation to a small, probabilistically selected subset of chunks per trajectory. PCM scores semantic phases using success-failure action variance, a rollout-derived proxy for per-phase gradient variance, and samples a fixed chunk budget with online-updated phase-level keep probabilities. We formalize per-phase gradient variance as the quantity determines where gradient computation is useful and show that success-failure action variance provides a measurable proxy for it. PCM requires no reward model or learned critic. On three LIBERO benchmarks, PCM matches the final success rate of standard GRPO while achieving 2.38 times wall-clock speedup, 4.8 times faster gradient updates, and 60% lower peak activation memory, while backpropagating through fewer than 20% of trajectory chunks.
tldr: This paper introduces Probabilistic Chunk Masking (PCM), a method to accelerate VLA policy reinforcement learning by focusing gradient computation on the most informative trajectory phases, achieving significant wall-clock speedups.
tldr_zh: 本文提出概率块掩码法，通过将梯度计算集中在最有信息量的轨迹阶段，加速VLA策略的强化学习，显著缩短了训练时间。
summary_zh: 强化学习（RL）能够通过直接优化任务成功率，使视觉-语言-动作策略泛化至超出训练分布的范围，但训练后计算成本高昂。对此，常见的应对方案是通过更快的模拟器和世界模型加速数据收集。在基于GRPO的视觉-语言-动作强化学习中，我们发现主要开销存在于其他环节：梯度计算在我们的实验中约占每步运行时长的78%，而数据收集仅占21%。梯度计算成本之所以占主导，是因为大量计算消耗在对学习贡献甚微的阶段。GRPO的学习信号由优势值方差驱动：只有在成功与失败数据轨迹产生差异的阶段才能产生有效学习信号。然而，GRPO会为轨迹中的每个数据块分配相同的优势值。这导致策略更新计算均匀消耗在整个轨迹上，包括预训练和监督微调后策略已能处理的阶段。本文提出概率性数据块掩码（PCM），这是一种对GRPO的直接改进方案，通过将梯度计算分配到每个轨迹中少量按概率选择的数据块子集来实现优化。PCM利用成功-失败动作方差（一种源于轨迹数据的阶段梯度方差替代指标）对语义阶段进行评分，并通过在线更新的阶段保留概率对固定数据块预算进行抽样。我们将阶段梯度方差形式化为决定梯度计算有效性的关键指标，并证明成功-失败动作方差可作为其可测量的替代指标。PCM无需奖励模型或学习评论器。在三个LIBERO基准测试中，PCM在达到标准GRPO最终成功率的同时，实现了2.38倍的运行速度提升、4.8倍的梯度更新加速以及60%的峰值激活内存降低，且仅需对少于20%的轨迹数据块进行反向传播。

title: Learning Sim-Grounded Policies for Bimanual Rope Manipulation from Human Teleoperation Data
summary: Deformable Linear Objects (DLOs) such as ropes and cables are widely encountered in both household and industrial applications, yet remain challenging to manipulate due to their infinite-dimensional configuration space and frequent self-occlusion. Imitation learning from teleoperation offers a practical path to bimanual DLO manipulation, but its scalability is limited by human effort, making the choice of observation space critical for generalization from small datasets. In this study, we investigate whether the lack of generalization in egocentric visual policies for the knot-untangling task stems from the observation space itself, rather than from the policy architecture or data scale. We compare two Action Chunking with Transformers policies trained on the same bimanual teleoperation data: a vision-based policy conditioned on two egocentric RGB streams from wrist-mounted cameras, and a state-based policy conditioned on the DLO's 3D particle state, extracted from an initial observation via multi-view fusion and evolved in a particle-based eXtended Position-Based Dynamics simulation. Evaluated open-loop on an unseen rope configuration, the state-based policy outperforms its visual counterpart with a 30.8% reduction in L1 error when predicting the initial grasp-and-pull action, quantifying the observability gap between pixels and physics-consistent state, and pointing toward more data-efficient robot learning for the DLO manipulation task from limited human demonstrations.
tldr: The paper compares imitation learning from teleoperation for bimanual rope manipulation, finding that a state-based policy using physics-consistent particle states outperforms a vision-based policy on an unseen rope configuration, highlighting an observability gap.
tldr_zh: 该论文比较了从遥操作中学习双手绳索操作的方法，发现使用基于物理一致粒子状态的状态策略在未见绳索配置上优于基于视觉的策略，突出了可观测性差距。
summary_zh: 可变线性物体（如绳索、线缆等）在家居与工业场景中广泛存在，但由于其无限维构型空间和频繁的自遮挡特性，其操控仍具挑战性。基于遥操作的模仿学习为双手协同操控可变线性物体提供了可行路径，但其扩展性受限于人工操作成本，因此观测空间的选择对于从小规模数据集中实现泛化至关重要。本研究探究了在解结任务中，以自我为中心的视觉策略泛化能力不足的根源是否在于观测空间本身，而非策略架构或数据规模。我们在同一组双手遥操作数据上训练了两种基于Transformer的动作分块策略：一种基于视觉的策略以腕戴式双目RGB视频流为输入，另一种基于状态的策略以可变线性物体的三维粒子状态为条件（该状态通过多视角融合从初始观测中提取，并在基于粒子的扩展位置动力学仿真中演化）。在未见过的绳索构型上进行开环评估时，基于状态的策略在预测初始抓取-拉动动作时，其L1误差较视觉策略降低了30.8%，这量化了像素信息与物理一致性状态之间的可观测性差距，并为基于有限人类示教数据实现更高效的数据驱动机器人学习指明了方向。

title: DiLA: Disentangled Latent Action World Models
summary: Latent Action Models (LAMs) enable the learning of world models from unlabeled video by inferring abstract actions between consecutive frames. However, LAMs face a fundamental trade-off between action abstraction and generation fidelity. Existing methods typically circumvent this issue by using two-stage training with pre-trained world models or by limiting predictions to optical flow. In this paper, we introduce DiLA, a novel Disentangled Latent Action world model that aims to resolve this trade-off via content-structure disentanglement. Our key insight is that disentanglement and latent action learning are co-evolving: the predictive bottleneck inherent in latent action learning serves as a driving force for disentanglement, compelling the model to distill spatial layouts into the structure pathway while offloading visual details to a separate content pathway for generation. This synergy yields a continuous, semantically structured latent action space without compromising generative quality. DiLA achieves superior results in video generation quality, action transfer, visual planning, and manifold interpretability. These findings establish DiLA as a unified framework that simultaneously achieves high-level action abstraction and high-fidelity generation, advancing the frontier of self-supervised world model learning.
tldr: DiLA introduces a disentangled latent action world model that learns continuous, semantically structured actions from unlabeled video via content-structure disentanglement, improving generation fidelity and action abstraction for visual planning and control.
tldr_zh: DiLA 提出了一种解耦的潜在行动世界模型，通过内容-结构解耦从无标签视频中学习连续、语义结构的动作，提高了生成保真度和行动抽象能力，用于视觉规划与控制。
summary_zh: 潜在动作模型（LAMs）通过推断连续帧之间的抽象动作，能够从无标注视频中学习世界模型。然而，LAMs在动作抽象性与生成保真度之间面临根本性的权衡。现有方法通常采用预训练世界模型的两阶段训练策略，或将预测范围限制在光流估计，以规避此问题。本文提出DiLA——一种新颖的解缠潜在动作世界模型，旨在通过内容与结构的解耦来化解这一权衡。我们的核心见解是：解缠学习与潜在动作学习具有协同演化关系：潜在动作学习固有的预测瓶颈驱动了解缠过程，迫使模型将空间布局提炼至结构通路，同时将视觉细节分流至独立的内容通路以进行生成。这种协同作用在不损害生成质量的前提下，构建出连续且语义结构化的潜在动作空间。DiLA在视频生成质量、动作迁移、视觉规划及流形可解释性方面均取得了优越成果。这些发现确立了DiLA作为统一框架，能够同时实现高级动作抽象与高保真度生成，从而推动了自监督世界模型学习的前沿发展。

title: Latent Video Prediction Learns Better World Models
summary: Self-supervised video models are increasingly framed as world models, yet their evaluation remains largely confined to a single top-1 accuracy score on clean benchmarks. This leaves a major gap in comprehending their potential as world models. We present the first systematic study addressing this gap, analyzing four matched-capacity frontier video foundation models, V-JEPA 2.1, V-JEPA 2, VideoPrism, and VideoMAEv2, across five robustness axes relevant to their deployment as video world models: feature discriminability, corruption robustness, fine-grained discrimination, occlusion robustness, and sensitivity to temporal direction. Our evaluations establish that across all five axes, latent-prediction models form a distinct and consistent profile. They degrade more gracefully under pixel corruption, preserve usable class structure rather than mere geometric stability under occlusion, capture fine-grained physical contact cues without reconstructing pixels, and uniquely encode the arrow of time. These advantages can even survive task adaptation: a frozen V-JEPA 2 backbone with a lightweight attentive probe outperforms a fully fine-tuned VideoMAE and a supervised TimeSformer on corruption and occlusion robustness. Our extensive results offer concrete new evidence in favor of latent prediction for robust world modeling.
tldr: This paper systematically evaluates the robustness of latent video prediction models for world modeling, showing they outperform other video foundation models in handling corruption, occlusion, and temporal order.
tldr_zh: 本文系统评估了视频潜在预测模型作为世界模型的鲁棒性，证明其在处理数据损坏、遮挡和时间顺序等方面优于其他视频基础模型。
summary_zh: 自监督视频模型日益被视为世界模型，但其评估仍主要局限于在干净基准测试中的单一top-1准确率指标。这导致对其作为世界模型的潜力理解存在重要缺口。本文首次通过系统研究填补这一空白，在五个与视频世界模型部署相关的鲁棒性维度上（特征可区分性、损坏鲁棒性、细粒度区分能力、遮挡鲁棒性、时间方向敏感性）分析了四个性能匹配的前沿视频基础模型：V-JEPA 2.1、V-JEPA 2、VideoPrism和VideoMAEv2。评估结果表明，在所有五个维度上，潜变量预测模型展现出独特且一致的特性：在像素损坏下性能退化更平缓；在遮挡情况下能保持可用的类别结构而非仅维持几何稳定性；无需像素重建即可捕捉细粒度物理接触线索；并独特地编码时间箭头方向。这些优势甚至能在任务适配后保留：仅冻结V-JEPA 2主干网络配合轻量级注意力探针，在损坏与遮挡鲁棒性方面即可超越完全微调的VideoMAE模型和有监督的TimeSformer模型。我们的大规模实验结果为潜变量预测实现鲁棒世界建模提供了具体的新证据。

title: STABLE: Simulation-Ready Tabletop Layout Generation via a Semantics-Physics Dual System
summary: Generating simulation-ready tabletop scenes from task instructions is an intriguing and promising research direction in the field of Embodied AI. However, existing task-to-scene generation methods rely exclusively on large language models (LLMs) to predict scene layouts, inevitably yielding object collisions or floating due to LLMs' inherent limitations in 3D spatial reasoning. In this paper, we present STABLE, a semantics-physics dual-system tailored for simulation-ready tabletop scene generation. STABLE consists of two complementary modules: (i) a Semantic Reasoner, a fine-tuned LLM trained on a structured tabletop scene dataset to generate coarse layouts from input task instructions, and (ii) a Physics Corrector, a physics-aware flow-based denoising model that outputs pose updates to refine layouts, which ensures the physical plausibility of scenes while preserves semantic alignment with task instructions. STABLE adopts a progressive generation paradigm: by alternating between the Semantic Reasoner and Physics Corrector, it incrementally expands the scene from task-critical objects to background objects. Experiments demonstrate that STABLE successfully generates simulation-ready tabletop scenes that strictly conform to task instructions and significantly enhances the physical validity of scenes over prior art.
tldr: A semantics-physics dual system for generating simulation-ready tabletop scenes from task instructions, using a fine-tuned LLM and a physics-aware corrector.
tldr_zh: 一个语义-物理双系统，用于从任务指令生成可直接用于仿真的桌面场景，使用微调LLM和物理感知修正器。
summary_zh: 根据任务指令生成可用于仿真的桌面场景是具身智能领域中一个引人注目且前景广阔的研究方向。然而，现有的任务到场景生成方法完全依赖大型语言模型预测场景布局，由于其在三维空间推理方面的固有局限性，不可避免地会产生物体碰撞或悬浮问题。本文提出STABLE，这是一个专为生成仿真就绪桌面场景而设计的语义-物理双系统。STABLE包含两个互补模块：(i) 语义推理器——基于结构化桌面场景数据集微调的大型语言模型，用于根据输入任务指令生成粗粒度布局；(ii) 物理校正器——基于物理感知的流式去噪模型，通过输出位姿更新来优化布局，在保持任务指令语义对齐的同时确保场景的物理合理性。STABLE采用渐进式生成范式：通过语义推理器与物理校正器的交替迭代，系统从任务关键对象到背景对象逐步扩展场景。实验表明，STABLE成功生成了严格遵循任务指令且可直接用于仿真的桌面场景，其场景物理有效性较现有方法得到显著提升。

title: WeatherOcc3D: VLM-Assisted Adverse Weather Aware 3D Semantic Occupancy Prediction
summary: While multi-modal 3D semantic occupancy prediction typically enhances robustness by fusing camera and LiDAR inputs, its effectiveness is fundamentally constrained by environmental variability. Specifically, camera sensors suffer from severe low-light degradation, while LiDAR sensors encounter significant backscatter noise during heavy precipitation. These adverse conditions create a modality trust problem, as static fusion strategies fail to adaptively re-weight inputs when a specific sensor becomes unreliable. To address this, we propose a VLM-assisted framework leveraging the pre-trained CLIP latent space to guide multi-sensor integration via linguistic environmental cues. We utilize a parameter-efficient adapter to align weather-specific text embeddings with sensor features, coupled with a gating strategy that decomposes environmental uncertainty into two factors: visibility and illumination. This enables the model to dynamically modulate the fusion ratio - prioritizing semantic camera features in clear daylight and shifting to geometric LiDAR priors during rainy nights. Evaluations on the nuScenes dataset demonstrate the versatility of our approach, as implementing our proposed framework on the OccMamba and M-CONet architectures achieves mIoU scores of 26.3 and 21.1, respectively, significantly outperforming their traditional baselines.
tldr: Proposes a VLM-assisted framework that uses linguistic environmental cues to adaptively re-weight camera and LiDAR sensor fusion for 3D semantic occupancy prediction under adverse weather conditions, improving robustness on the nuScenes dataset.
tldr_zh: 提出了一个VLM辅助的框架，利用语言环境线索，针对恶劣天气条件自适应地重新加权相机和LiDAR传感器的融合，以进行3D语义占据预测，在nuScenes数据集上提升了鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 多模态3D语义占据预测通常通过融合相机与激光雷达输入来增强鲁棒性，但其效果从根本上受限于环境变化。具体而言，相机传感器在低光照条件下性能严重退化，而激光雷达在强降水期间会遭遇显著的后向散射噪声。这些不利条件引发了模态信任问题，因为当特定传感器可靠性下降时，静态融合策略无法自适应地重新权衡输入信息。为解决这一问题，我们提出一种视觉语言模型辅助框架，利用预训练的CLIP潜在空间，通过语言化环境线索指导多传感器集成。我们采用参数高效的适配器，将特定天气文本嵌入与传感器特征对齐，并结合门控策略将环境不确定性分解为两个因子：可见度与光照强度。这使得模型能够动态调节融合比例——在晴朗白天优先考虑语义相机特征，在雨夜则转向几何激光雷达先验。在nuScenes数据集上的评估验证了我们方法的普适性：在OccMamba与M-CONet架构中应用该框架后，分别取得了26.3与21.1的mIoU分数，显著优于传统基线方法。

title: Hierarchical and Holistic Open-Vocabulary Functional 3D Scene Graphs for Indoor Spaces
summary: Functional 3D scene graphs offer a versatile and flexible representation for 3D scene understanding and robotic manipulation, defined by object nodes, interactive elements, and functional relationship edges. However, their potential remains underexplored due to the limited coverage of existing benchmarks and the overly straightforward design of previous pipelines, which primarily focus on large-scale furniture but lack of hierarchical structures. Therefore, in this work, we extend the benchmark coverage by introducing dense tabletop objects and explicit multi-level functional relationships. This expansion introduces critical challenges involving small-scale, dense, and similar instances, with lack of visual anchoring in relational reasoning, instance confusion during cross-frame fusion, and attribution uncertainty under dynamic viewpoints. To address these issues, we propose an open-vocabulary pipeline based on 2D visual grounding and 3D graph optimization. Specifically, we anchor fine-grained functional edges from 2D visual evidence, and associate nodes across frames in 3D using multiple cues. Furthermore, edge association is formulated as temporal graph optimization, integrating evidence accumulation, entropy regularization, and temporal smoothing to robustly determine the functional connections of each node. Finally, global hierarchy shaping is performed to recover the hierarchical graph structure. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed method can reliably infer functional 3D scene graphs in challenging real-world scenes, thereby further unlocking their potential for practical applications.
tldr: The paper introduces a pipeline for open-vocabulary, hierarchical functional 3D scene graph construction, focusing on dense tabletop objects and multi-level relationships to enhance 3D scene understanding for robotic manipulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种开放词汇的分层功能性3D场景图构建流程，专注于密集桌面物体和多层次关系，以增强机器人操作所需的3D场景理解。
summary_zh: 功能性三维场景图通过物体节点、交互元素和功能关系边，为三维场景理解与机器人操作提供了灵活通用的表示形式。然而，现有基准数据集覆盖范围有限，且先前流程设计过于简化——主要聚焦于大型家具而缺乏层次化结构，导致其潜力尚未被充分发掘。为此，本研究通过引入密集桌面物体和显式多层级功能关系，拓展了基准数据集的覆盖范围。这一扩展带来了涉及小尺度、密集及相似实例的关键挑战，包括关系推理中视觉锚点缺失、跨帧融合时的实例混淆，以及动态视角下的属性归因不确定性。为解决这些问题，我们提出一种基于二维视觉定位与三维图优化的开放词汇流程。具体而言，我们从二维视觉证据中锚定细粒度功能边，并利用多维线索在三维空间中跨帧关联节点。此外，将边关联问题建模为时序图优化，整合证据累积、熵正则化与时序平滑技术，以鲁棒地确定各节点的功能连接关系。最终通过全局层次结构塑造恢复层次化图结构。大量实验表明，该方法能在具有挑战性的真实场景中可靠推断功能性三维场景图，从而进一步释放其在实际应用中的潜力。

title: Mind Dreamer: Untethering Imagination via Active Latent Intervention on Latent Manifolds
summary: Model-Based Reinforcement Learning (MBRL) leverages latent imagination for sample efficiency, yet remains constrained by Historical Tethering: imagination is typically initialized from observed states. This creates a learning asymmetry, where the world model's manifold discovery outpaces the policy's sparse-reward optimization. We propose Mind Dreamer (MD), a framework that operationalizes Active Latent Intervention (ALI) to transcend Markovian continuity. MD reformulates discovery as the minimization of a global Relay Manifold Expected Free Energy (R-EFE); by sampling initial states from a learned generator $s_0 \sim p_{gen}(\cdot)$ rather than the historical buffer, MD utilizes an adversarial generator to synthesize non-continuous latent jumps to epistemic blind spots that are physically plausible yet cognitively challenging. To resolve the credit assignment paradox across these spatial ruptures, we derive the Relay Value Function (RVF) and Relay Uncertainty Function (RUF). These potentials treat synthesized anchors as counterfactual intermediary states, propagating pragmatic and epistemic value through a principled Bellman-style formulation. Notably, we prove that uncertainty propagation across discontinuities necessitates a quadratic discount $γ^2$, establishing a formal epistemic horizon. Theoretically, MD approximates a variance-minimizing importance sampler that expands the manifold's spectral gap, reducing the hitting time to critical bottleneck states. Empirically, MD achieves a 1.67$\times$ average speedup over DreamerV3 on DeepMind Control Suite, reaching 8.8$\times$ in sparse-reward tasks.
tldr: This paper proposes Mind Dreamer, a model-based RL framework that actively synthesizes non-continuous yet plausible state transitions to overcome the limitations of historical tethering and improve sample efficiency.
tldr_zh: 本文提出Mind Dreamer，一个基于模型的强化学习框架，通过主动合成非连续但物理可行的状态转移，以克服历史绑定的限制并提高样本效率。
summary_zh: 基于模型的强化学习（MBRL）利用潜在想象提高样本效率，但始终受制于历史锚定现象：想象通常从观测状态初始化。这导致了学习不对称性，即世界模型的流形发现速度远超策略的稀疏奖励优化能力。我们提出“心智梦想家”（MD）框架，通过实施主动潜在干预（ALI）来突破马尔可夫连续性约束。MD将发现过程重新定义为最小化全局接力流形期望自由能（R-EFE）：通过从学习生成器$s_0 \sim p_{gen}(\cdot)$而非历史缓冲区中采样初始状态，MD利用对抗生成器合成具有物理合理性但认知挑战性的非连续潜在跳跃，以探索认知盲区。为解决跨空间断裂的信用分配悖论，我们推导出接力价值函数（RVF）与接力不确定性函数（RUF）。这两种势能将合成锚点视为反事实中间状态，通过严谨的贝尔曼式公式传播实用价值与认知价值。特别地，我们证明跨越非连续性的不确定性传播需引入二次折扣因子$γ^2$，从而确立形式化的认知边界。理论分析表明，MD近似于方差最小化重要性采样器，可扩展流形谱间隙，缩短抵达关键瓶颈状态的命中时间。实验显示，在DeepMind控制套件中MD较DreamerV3平均加速1.67倍，在稀疏奖励任务中更达到8.8倍加速效果。

title: Adaptive Outer-Loop Control of Quadrotors via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) for quadrotor flight control typically relies on Domain Randomization (DR) for sim-to-real transfer, resulting in overly conservative policies that struggle with dynamic disturbances. To overcome this, we propose a novel adaptive control architecture that actively perceives and reacts to instantaneous perturbations. First, we train an optimal outer-loop policy, then replace its reliance on ground-truth disturbance data with a Residual Dynamics Predictor (RDP). The RDP estimates the external forces and moments acting on the aircraft in flight online using only the history of states and control actions. For seamless hardware transfer, we introduce a data-efficient linear calibration bridge and an online thrust correction mechanism that align the simulated latent space with reality using mere seconds of flight data. Real-world validations on a Crazyflie micro-quadrotor demonstrate that our adaptive controller significantly outperforms baselines, maintaining precise trajectory tracking under severe uncertainties including mass variations, asymmetric payloads, and dynamic slung loads
tldr: This paper proposes an adaptive outer-loop control architecture for quadrotors using reinforcement learning and a residual dynamics predictor to improve robustness against dynamic disturbances, achieving precise trajectory tracking in real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于强化学习的自适应外环控制架构，用于四旋翼无人机。它通过残差动力学预测器在线估计外部扰动，从而在质量变化、不对称负载等动态干扰下实现精确的轨迹跟踪。
summary_zh: 四旋翼飞行器深度强化学习控制通常依赖于域随机化进行仿真到现实的迁移，这往往导致控制策略过于保守，难以应对动态扰动。为克服这一局限，我们提出一种新型自适应控制架构，能够主动感知并响应瞬时扰动。首先训练最优外环控制策略，随后通过残差动态预测器替代其对真实扰动数据的依赖。该预测器仅需历史状态与控制指令，即可在线实时估算飞行中作用于飞行器的外力和力矩。为实现高效硬件迁移，我们引入数据高效的线性校准桥接与在线推力校正机制，仅需数秒飞行数据即可使仿真潜空间与真实世界对齐。在Crazyflie微型四旋翼平台上的真实环境验证表明，该自适应控制器在质量变化、非对称载荷及动态悬挂负载等严峻不确定条件下，仍能保持精确轨迹跟踪能力，其性能显著优于现有基准方法。

title: parallelcbf: A composable safety-filter and auditability framework for tensor-parallel reinforcement learning
summary: While Isaac Lab provides massive parallel UAV simulation, OmniSafe and safe-control-gym provide constrained-RL benchmarks, and CBFKit provides control-barrier-function synthesis tooling, no existing framework unifies these capabilities for end-to-end safety-constrained training. ParallelCBF is the first framework to unify (i)~tensor-parallel UAV environments, (ii)~hard-gate CBF safety filters, (iii)~sharded BC-to-RL pipelines, and (iv)~first-class operational auditability -- pre-registration, watchdog registries, failure forensics, and dataset audits as composable APIs rather than user-implemented scripts. We release ParallelCBF v0.1.0 under Apache~2.0 with a four-layer composable API, a CPU PyTorch reference implementation of a dual-barrier (squared / linear-predictive) CBF, property-based safety invariance tests across vectorized batch sizes that complete in 1.67~s for the full 39-test suite, and a 31{,}415-episode behavior-cloning collection campaign whose curriculum mix, per-bucket yields, and dataset SHA-256 are auditable through the framework's own \texttt{ops} primitives. We report a representative end-to-end pipeline execution in which the framework's auditability layer halted a downstream training stage that did not meet pre-registered convergence criteria, preventing silent propagation of a degraded checkpoint -- an architectural property we argue is necessary, not merely useful, for reproducible empirical robotics research. The framework is installable via \texttt{pip install parallelcbf}; source and release artifacts are available at https://github.com/xiaoyang-123-cell/ParallelCBF.
tldr: ParallelCBF is a unified framework for safety-constrained, tensor-parallel RL training for UAVs, featuring composable safety filters and built-in operational auditability.
tldr_zh: ParallelCBF是一个用于无人机安全约束、张量并行强化学习的统一框架，包含可组合的安全过滤器和内置的可操作审计功能。
summary_zh: 尽管Isaac Lab提供大规模并行无人机仿真，OmniSafe和safe-control-gym提供约束强化学习基准，CBFKit提供控制屏障函数合成工具，但现有框架均未将这些能力整合为端到端安全约束训练方案。ParallelCBF是首个实现四大功能统一的框架：(i) 张量并行无人机环境，(ii) 硬门限控制屏障函数安全过滤器，(iii) 分片行为克隆至强化学习训练管线，(iv) 原生操作可审计性——通过可组合API（而非用户实现脚本）提供预注册、监控注册表、故障溯源及数据集审计功能。我们以Apache 2.0协议发布ParallelCBF v0.1.0，其包含四层可组合API、基于CPU PyTorch的双屏障（平方/线性预测）控制屏障函数参考实现、可在1.67秒内完成39项全测试套件的向量化批次规模属性安全不变性测试，以及包含31,415回合的行为克隆采集实验——该实验的课程混合策略、分桶产出率及数据集SHA-256哈希均可通过框架内置的`ops`原语进行审计。我们展示了具有代表性的端到端管线执行案例：当某下游训练阶段未满足预注册的收敛标准时，框架的审计层自动中止了训练进程，防止了性能退化检查点的隐性传播——我们认为这种架构特性对于可复现的实证机器人研究具有必要性而不仅是实用性。该框架可通过`pip install parallelcbf`安装，源代码及发布构件详见https://github.com/xiaoyang-123-cell/ParallelCBF。

title: Imperfect World Models are Exploitable
summary: We propose a novel definition of model exploitation in reinforcement learning. Informally, a world model is exploitable if it implies that one policy should be strictly preferred over another while the environment's true transition model implies the reverse. We analogize our definition with a prior characterization of reward hacking but show that the associated proof of inevitability does not transfer to exploitation. To overcome this obstruction, we develop a general theory of reward hacking and model exploitation that proves that exploitation is essentially unavoidable on large policy sets and yields the corresponding claim for hacking as a special case. Unfortunately, we also find that the conditions that guarantee unhackability in finite policy sets have no counterpart that precludes exploitation. Consequently, we introduce a relaxed notion of exploitation and derive a safe horizon within which it can be avoided. Taken together, our results establish a formal bridge between reward hacking and model exploitation and elucidate the limits of safe planning in world models.
tldr: The paper formalizes model exploitation in RL, showing world models can be fundamentally exploitable even when reward hacking is preventable, and derives a safe planning horizon.
tldr_zh: 该论文形式化了强化学习中的模型利用，表明即使奖励破解可预防，世界模型在根本上也可能被利用，并推导出了一个安全规划范围。
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种强化学习中模型利用的新定义。通俗而言，当一个世界模型暗示某策略应严格优于另一策略，而环境真实的转移模型却表明相反结论时，该世界模型即具有可被利用性。我们将此定义与已有的奖励破解理论进行类比，但证明其必然性论证无法直接迁移至模型利用场景。为突破此障碍，我们建立了奖励破解与模型利用的统一理论框架，证明在大型策略集合中利用现象本质上是不可避免的，并将奖励破解的相应结论作为特例纳入该框架。值得注意的是，我们发现有限策略集合中保证奖励不可破解的条件无法对应到阻止模型利用的情形。因此，我们引入了弱化的利用定义，并推导出可避免利用的安全边界范围。综上所述，本研究成果在奖励破解与模型利用之间建立了形式化理论桥梁，并揭示了世界模型中安全规划的根本性局限。

title: Structure Abstraction and Generalization in a Hippocampal-Entorhinal Inspired World Model
summary: Humans abstract experiences into structured representations to facilitate pattern inference and knowledge transfer. While the hippocampal-entorhinal (HPC-MEC) circuit is known to represent both spatial and conceptual spaces, the mechanisms for concurrently extracting abstract structures from continuous, high-dimensional dynamics remain poorly understood. We propose a brain-inspired hierarchical model that simultaneously infers latent transitions and constructs a predictive visual world model. Our architecture employs an inverse model for structural extraction alongside an HPC-MEC coupling model that dissociates relational structures (MEC) from integrated episodic scenes (HPC). Using primitive transformation dynamics as a benchmark, we demonstrate the model's capacity for structural abstraction. By leveraging velocity-driven path integration, the framework enables robust prediction and structural reuse across diverse contexts, thereby achieving structural generalization. This work provides a novel computational framework for understanding how brain-inspired, self-supervised learning of world models facilitates the acquisition of reusable abstract knowledge.
tldr: Proposes a brain-inspired hierarchical world model that learns to abstract structured representations from visual dynamics to enable robust prediction and structural generalization across contexts.
tldr_zh: 提出一种受大脑启发的分层世界模型，从视觉动态中学习抽象结构表示，以实现跨上下文的稳健预测和结构泛化。
summary_zh: 人类将经验抽象为结构化表征，以促进模式推断与知识迁移。尽管已知海马-内嗅皮层（HPC-MEC）环路能够同时表征空间与概念空间，但如何从连续的高维动态中同步提取抽象结构的机制仍不清楚。我们提出一种受大脑启发的分层模型，该模型能够同步推断潜在状态跃迁并构建可预测的视觉世界模型。该架构采用逆向模型进行结构提取，同时结合HPC-MEC耦合模型，实现关系结构（MEC）与整合式情景场景（HPC）的分离。以原始变换动态为基准，我们验证了该模型的结构抽象能力。通过利用速度驱动的路径积分机制，该框架能够在不同情境下实现鲁棒预测与结构复用，从而达成结构泛化。本研究为理解受大脑启发的世界模型自监督学习如何促进可复用抽象知识的获取，提供了一个新颖的计算框架。

title: LAPS: Improving Incremental LiDAR Mapping using Active Pooling and Sampling for Neural Distance Fields
summary: Neural distance fields offer a compact and continuous representation of 3D geometry, making them attractive for incremental LiDAR mapping. However, their online optimization is vulnerable to catastrophic forgetting, where new observations can degrade previously reconstructed geometry. Replay-based training is commonly used to address this issue, but existing methods typically rely on passive replay buffers and uniform sampling, which can waste memory on redundant observations and under-train poorly constrained regions. We propose LAPS, a replay management framework for incremental neural mapping that improves both replay retention and replay allocation during online updates. LAPS combines reliability-based active pooling to retain reliable historical samples under limited memory with uncertainty-guided active sampling to focus optimization on under-constrained regions. Experiments on synthetic and real-world benchmarks show that LAPS consistently improves reconstruction completeness while maintaining competitive geometric accuracy. On Oxford Spires, it improves recall by 4.66 pp and F1-score by 3.79 pp over PIN-SLAM on the Blenheim Palace 05 sequence. We release our open source implementation at: https://github.com/dongjae0107/LAPS.
tldr: LAPS proposes an active replay management framework for incremental neural LiDAR mapping, using reliability-based active pooling and uncertainty-guided sampling to improve reconstruction completeness and mitigate catastrophic forgetting.
tldr_zh: LAPS提出了一种用于增量神经激光雷达建图的主动回放管理框架，通过基于可靠性的主动池化和不确定性引导的采样，提高了重建的完整性并缓解了灾难性遗忘。
summary_zh: 神经距离场为三维几何提供了紧凑且连续的表征形式，使其在增量式激光雷达建图中具有显著优势。然而，其在线优化过程易受灾难性遗忘影响，新观测可能损坏已重建的几何结构。回放式训练是解决此问题的常用方法，但现有方法通常依赖被动回放缓冲区与均匀采样策略，这既可能因冗余观测浪费内存，又可能导致约束薄弱区域的训练不足。本文提出LAPS——一种面向增量神经建图的回放管理框架，该框架通过改进在线更新过程中的回放保留机制与回放分配策略来提升性能。LAPS融合了基于可靠性的主动池化策略（在有限内存下保留可靠历史样本）与不确定性引导的主动采样策略（将优化重点聚焦于约束薄弱区域）。在合成与真实场景基准测试上的实验表明，LAPS在保持优异几何精度的同时，持续提升了重建完整性。在牛津尖塔数据集上，针对布莱尼姆宫05序列，相较PIN-SLAM方法，LAPS将召回率提升4.66个百分点，F1分数提升3.79个百分点。我们已在https://github.com/dongjae0107/LAPS发布开源实现。

title: Entity-Centric World Models: Interaction-Aware Masking for Causal Video Prediction
summary: Learning predictive world models from unlabelled video is a foundational challenge in artificial intelligence. While Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPA) have set new benchmarks in semantic classification, they often remain physics-blind, failing to capture the causal dynamics necessary for downstream reasoning. We hypothesize that this stems from standard patch-based masking strategies, which prioritize visual texture over rare but informative kinematic events. We propose Interaction-Aware JEPA (IA-JEPA), which utilizes a self-supervised motion-centric masking strategy to prioritize physical interactions. By specifically targeting entities engaged in collisions or momentum transfers, we force the architecture to reconstruct latent trajectories rather than static background features. Evaluated on the CLEVRER benchmark, IA-JEPA achieves 14.26% accuracy on causal reasoning tasks, a significant lead over the 3.22% achieved by standard patch-masked baselines. Crucially, we demonstrate that IA-JEPA breaks the "static bias" of standard self-supervision by inducing a higher-entropy, more discriminative latent space (+10% entropy gain) that linearizes physical energy ($R^2=0.43$). We show that this interaction bias generalizes to real-world human actions (Something-Something V2) and zero-shot physical puzzles (PHYRE-Lite). Our results provide a scalable, fully self-supervised path toward building foundational world models that begin to internalize the causal structure of the physical world.
tldr: The paper proposes Interaction-Aware JEPA, a self-supervised video prediction model with a motion-centric masking strategy to prioritize physical interactions, improving causal reasoning and latent space linearization of physical energy on physics-based benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种交互感知的JEPA模型，通过以运动为中心的掩码策略优先处理物理交互，在基于物理的基准测试中提高了因果推理能力，并实现了物理能量的潜在空间线性化。
summary_zh: 从无标签视频中学习预测性世界模型是人工智能领域的一项基础性挑战。联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）虽已在语义分类任务中树立了新标杆，但其往往对物理规律不敏感，难以捕捉下游推理所必需的因果动力学。我们认为，这源于标准基于图像块的掩码策略过度关注视觉纹理，却忽略了罕见但富含信息量的运动学事件。我们提出交互感知型JEPA（IA-JEPA），采用以运动为中心的自监督掩码策略来优先处理物理交互。通过专门针对参与碰撞或动量传递的实体进行建模，我们迫使架构重构潜在运动轨迹而非静态背景特征。在CLEVRER基准测试中，IA-JEPA在因果推理任务上达到14.26%的准确率，显著优于基于标准图像块掩码基线3.22%的表现。关键的是，我们证明IA-JEPA通过诱导出更高熵值、更具判别性的潜在空间（熵值增益+10%）并实现物理能量的线性化表征（R^2=0.43），从而打破了标准自监督方法的“静态偏差”。我们进一步证明这种交互偏向性可泛化至真实世界人类动作数据集（Something-Something V2）及零样本物理推理任务（PHYRE-Lite）。我们的研究为构建内化物理世界因果结构的基础世界模型，提供了一条可扩展的、完全自监督的技术路径。

title: Where to Perch in a Tree: Vision-Guidance for Tree-Grasping Drones
summary: This study demonstrates a method to locate an ideal perch location on a tree for vision-guided autonomous tree-perching drones. Various image processing algorithms, including those used for machine learning, image segmentation and binary image morphology, are implemented to assess the shape and structure of a tree. Rather than identifying the closest available branch, this study builds on vision methods by evaluating the potential of each branch, determining its suitability for perching based on factors such as branch width, slope (angle to the horizontal) and curvature. For a given tree-perching drone and a dataset of more than 10,000 urban tree images taken from February to October in a subtropical and temperate monsoon climate, the proposed method successfully produces a result for 76% of feasible targets. A feasible target defined as a tree where the branch diameters are sufficiently thick and where the available perching space is at least equal to the width of a tendon-driven grasping claw. These successful preliminary results create a foundation from which a number of identified improvements and additional features can be developed to create a generalised method; this will involve the incorporation of supplementary data from depth perception and attitude sensors to enhance the branch assessment.
tldr: The paper presents a vision-based method for autonomous drones to locate and evaluate suitable perching branches on trees, using image processing and machine learning to assess branch geometry for grasping.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于视觉的方法，使自主无人机能够定位和评估树木上适合栖息的树枝，使用图像处理和机器学习来评估抓取的树枝几何形状。
summary_zh: 本研究展示了一种为视觉引导的自主树栖无人机在树上定位理想栖息位置的方法。研究运用了多种图像处理算法，包括机器学习、图像分割和二值图像形态学处理，以评估树木的形状和结构。与仅识别最近可用枝条不同，本研究基于视觉方法评估每个枝条的潜力，根据枝条宽度、斜率（与水平面夹角）和曲率等因素判定其适宜栖息程度。针对特定树栖无人机，以及二月至十月在亚热带和温带季风气候下采集的超过10,000张城市树木图像数据集，所提方法对76%的可行目标成功生成结果。可行目标定义为枝条直径足够粗壮且可用栖息空间至少等于腱驱动抓爪宽度的树木。这些成功的初步结果为后续开发通用方法奠定了基础，可通过整合深度感知和姿态传感器的补充数据来增强枝条评估能力，从而实现一系列已识别的改进与功能拓展。

title: Minerva-Ego: Spatiotemporal Hints for Egocentric Video Understanding
summary: Video reasoning models are a core component of egocentric and embodied agents. However, standard benchmarks for assessing models provide only evaluation of the output (e.g. the answer to a question), without evaluation of intermediate reasoning steps, and most provide answers only in the text domain. We introduce Minerva-Ego, a benchmark for evaluating complex egocentric visual reasoning. We extend recent high-quality video data sources recorded from egocentric / embodied settings with a set of challenging, multi-step multimodal questions and spatiotemporally-dense human-annotated reasoning traces. Benchmarking experiments show that state-of-the-art models still have a large gap to human performance. To investigate this gap in detail, we annotate each reasoning trace in the dataset with the objects of interest required to solve the question, as spatiotemporal mask annotations. Through extensive evaluations, we identify that prompting frontier models with hints of 'where' and 'when' to look yields substantial improvements in performance. Minerva-Ego can be downloaded at https://github.com/google-deepmind/neptune.
tldr: The paper introduces Minerva-Ego, a benchmark for evaluating complex egocentric visual reasoning with multi-step multimodal questions, spatiotemporally-dense reasoning traces, and mask annotations, showing prompting with spatiotemporal hints improves model performance.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了Minerva-Ego，一个用于评估复杂第一人称视觉推理的基准，包含多步多模态问题、时空密集的推理轨迹和掩码标注，表明使用时空间提示能显著提升模型性能。
summary_zh: 视频推理模型是第一人称和具身智能体中的核心组件。然而，用于评估模型的标准基准测试仅对输出结果（例如问题的答案）进行评估，未对中间推理步骤进行评价，且多数基准测试仅提供文本领域的答案。本文提出了Minerva-Ego——一个用于评估复杂第一人称视觉推理的基准测试系统。我们基于近期高质量的第一人称/具身环境录制视频数据，构建了一组具有挑战性的多步骤多模态问题及高时空密度的人工标注推理轨迹。基准测试实验表明，当前最先进的模型性能与人类表现仍存在显著差距。为深入探究这一差距，我们在数据集中为每个推理轨迹标注了解决问题所需关注的目标对象，以时空掩码标注的形式呈现。通过大量实验评估，我们发现向前沿模型提供“关注何处”与“何时关注”的提示线索能显著提升模型性能。Minerva-Ego可通过https://github.com/google-deepmind/neptune下载获取。

title: IVGT: Implicit Visual Geometry Transformer for Neural Scene Representation
summary: Reconstructing coherent 3D geometry and appearance from unposed multi-view images is a fundamental yet challenging problem in computer vision. Most existing visual geometry foundation models predict explicit geometry by regressing pixel-aligned pointmaps, often suffering from redundancy and limited geometric continuity. We propose IVGT, an Implicit Visual Geometry Transformer that implicitly models continuous and coherent geometry from pose-free multi-view images. This formulation learns a continuous neural scene representation in a canonical coordinate system and supports continuous spatial queries at any 3D positions, retrieving local features to predict signed distance (SDF) values and colors using lightweight decoders. It allows direct extraction of continuous and coherent surface geometry, enabling rendering of RGB images, depth maps, and surface normal maps from arbitrary viewpoints. We train IVGT via multi-dataset joint optimization with 2D supervision and 3D geometric regularization. IVGT demonstrates generalization across scenes and achieves strong performance on various tasks, including mesh and point cloud reconstruction, novel view synthesis, depth and surface normal estimation, and camera pose estimation.
tldr: Proposes IVGT, an implicit visual geometry transformer for reconstructing coherent 3D geometry and appearance from unposed multi-view images, enabling continuous neural scene representation and view synthesis.
tldr_zh: 提出IVGT，一种隐式视觉几何变换器，用于从无位姿多视图图像重建连贯的3D几何与外观，实现连续的神经场景表示和视图合成。

title: Deterministic Event-Graph Substrates as World Models for Counterfactual Reasoning
summary: We study event-graph substrates: a class of world models that represent agent state as an append-only log of typed RDF triples and answer counterfactual queries by forking the log under a structured intervention vocabulary. Substrates are inspectable at the triple level, support exact counterfactuals, and transfer across domains without learned components. We formalize the class, prove a duality between explanatory and counterfactual queries that reduces both to the same causal-ancestor traversal, and evaluate a 1,400-line CLEVRER-DSL interpreter atop a domain-agnostic substrate runtime at full CLEVRER validation scale (n=75,618). The substrate exceeds the NS-DR symbolic oracle on all four per-question categories (by 9.89, 20.26, 17.65, and 0.80 percentage points), and exceeds the parametric ALOE baseline on descriptive and explanatory while lagging on predictive and counterfactual. We also introduce twin-EventLog, a 500-specification Park-canonical Smallville counterfactual benchmark on which the substrate exceeds Llama-3.1-8B with full context by 18.80 points joint accuracy.
tldr: This paper introduces event-graph substrates, a class of inspectable world models for deterministic counterfactual reasoning, and demonstrates their performance on CLEVRER and a new counterfactual benchmark.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了事件图基底，一种用于确定性反事实推理的可检查世界模型类，并在CLEVRER和新的反事实基准测试中展示了其性能。

title: A Topology-Aware Spatiotemporal Handover Framework for Continuous Multi-UAV Tracking
summary: The integration of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles(UAVs) into Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) offers synoptic visibility for traffic monitoring, yet scalable deployment is hindered by trajectory fragmentation, where vehicle identity persistence is lost across multi-UAV Fields of View (FOV).
